# Xerovan

> Xerovan is a technology platform (pre-launch) that brings crypto wallets, payments, rewards, travel and business spending together in one secure app: a self-custodial MPC multi-wallet, crypto swaps and cross-chain bridging, virtual and physical Visa cards funded with crypto, staking and cashback rewards, a travel marketplace (flights, hotels, tours, eSIM) and business cards with expense controls. Xerovan is not a bank; card and payment services are provided by licensed partners, and availability varies by country.

The site is available in English, Korean, Japanese, Spanish, Arabic and Portuguese. Xerovan has not launched yet; people can join the waitlist on any language page.

## Main pages

## Solutions

- [Virtual cards for ad spend](https://www.xerovan.com/en/solutions/crypto-card-for-ads): dedicated cards per client, campaign and ad platform, funded with crypto
- [Card for international subscriptions](https://www.xerovan.com/en/solutions/card-for-international-subscriptions): a virtual Visa card for USD-billed AI, SaaS, cloud and streaming services
- [Crypto travel card](https://www.xerovan.com/en/solutions/crypto-travel-card): spend abroad with Visa, Apple Pay and Google Pay, and book flights, hotels and eSIM
- [Spend crypto with Visa](https://www.xerovan.com/en/solutions/spend-crypto-with-visa): self-custodial multi-chain wallet connected to a Visa card
- Each page is also available in Korean, Japanese, Spanish, Arabic and Portuguese (replace /en/ with /kr/, /ja/, /es/, /ar/ or /pt/)
